collection.description: Caregivers disagree over whether the nursery should be quiet, musical, or full of activity.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Caregivers disagree over whether the nursery should be quiet, musical, or full of activity.

choices.label: Watch What the Children Respond To

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Babies nap peacefully while older children anticipate story time.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The schedule proves too rigid, so caregivers adjust it to each child.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A lullaby from another tribe becomes a nursery favorite.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Two families discover their soothing routines differ and respectfully keep both.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) offers practical advice without insisting it is universal.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (caregiver), a younger caregiver, politely corrects an outdated assumption.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A fussy infant calms at the sound of a familiar voice.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One child loves music while another covers their ears, prompting quieter options.
